generation.scope: In a standard regular window the centers of positive-dimensional projection fibers have dimension at most one on every edge. A curve of such centers sweeps out an irreducible surface in the next letter, and all but finitely many of its points also have predecessors. The surface bound allows singular cubics and does not assume absence of pure relations.
